problems: REPORT NOT FOUND / NOT CONFIDENTLY IDENTIFIED. (1) Short cite 'Reid et al. 2014' has no DOI/URL/full citation in any source: studies.csv row 95, worklist_unpublished.json, S3.1/S3.2, the main-article reference list, and the supplement all give only the short cite. (2) Exhaustive searching found NO first-author 'Reid' 2014 publication fitting the profile: ERIC API (author:Reid, 2013/2014/2015 -> 36 records in 2014, none a K-2 reading-curriculum QED), OpenAlex (raw_author_name:reid x reading title; education-concept), Crossref (author Reid + reading PD achievement 2013-2015), Semantic Scholar, WWC, Google Scholar (web). Reid authors that surface are all off-profile (Ethna R. Reid=ECRI, but its evals are 1986/1990/1996 not 2014 & failed WWC standards; Erin Reid=early math; Jonson-Reid=Experience Corps tutoring 2012; Robert Reid=SRSD/self-reg writing; Ken/Jeanne/etc.). (3) Checked the candidate source-review study lists from supplement Section 1 (Basma & Savage 2017; Didion et al. 2020; Neitzel, Lake et al. 2022 incl. its public GitHub dataset + BEE preprint; Pellegrini et al. 2021): the ONLY 'Reid' anywhere is 'Jonson-Reid' (Experience Corps, 2012) -- no K-2 reading QED attributable to a 'Reid 2014'. (4) NEAR-MISS RE-EVALUATED AND REJECTED ON DESIGN GROUNDS: Amendum, S. J., & Fitzgerald, J. (2013), 'Does Structure of Content Delivery or Degree of Professional Development Support Matter for Student Reading Growth in High-Poverty Settings?', Journal of Literacy Research 45(4), 465-502 (ERIC EJ1019634), and its sibling Amendum 2008 UNC dissertation / 'Federal Funding Matters' (JESPAR) match the CONTENT fingerprint almost exactly (K-2, two-year reading growth, high-poverty/low-performing schools, 'structure of content delivery'=curricula + 'degree of PD support'=coaching/support, school level). BUT both are predictive/correlational HLM studies of variation among Reading-Excellence-Act-funded schools with NO business-as-usual control group and NO TPD-vs-control contrast -- they FAIL the meta-analysis's core inclusion criteria (BAU control; SMD/Hedges g computable from a treatment-vs-control contrast). They are also wrong author and wrong year. So even as a possible mis-citation they do not fit the registry's 'QED' (treatment vs matched control) coding, and cannot be substituted for 'Reid et al. 2014'. (5) The main article's reference list does NOT enumerate the 128 included studies, so the citation is unrecoverable from the publication; the most plausible explanation is an interview-sourced unpublished gray-literature report (same class as Miller 2017 / Stokes 2018 / Yang 2020). NO PDF obtained; NO effect sizes extracted. RECOMMENDATION: request the included-study reference list / coding sheet directly from the corresponding author (Visscher; see email/data_request.md) -- this is the only reliable path to resolve 'Reid et al. 2014' (and the other 3 unidentifiable short cites).
